published_contract.status: Types published; backend implementation/protobuf/canonical projection remain a separate closure. No service implementation is inferred from types.
published_contract.version_rule: WorldView.ui.version must equal 1. Absent, unknown or malformed projections are explicit unsupported/error states, never fabricated empty views.

published_audio_policy.volume_argument: Source normalized slider position; percent/100 is sent exactly once, never mixer/native asset gain.
published_audio_policy.current_values: bindUiAudio uses actual observed percentages/mixers and per-voice renderedNativeLevel/appliedNativeLevel. sourceMixerToAssetGain uses the actual 128 or 255 denominator, never an assumed music-channel gain.

wired_versioned_controls: Opaque inventory action IDs with canonical item and instance identity; declared permission rejection, local use selection and no optimistic ownership changes.

Production menu/recipe IDs, single versus make_x permission, 1/5/10/X requests, native one-through-eighteen-choice layouts and the source bronze smithing table. Unoffered source rows remain present with explicit feedback.
Quest reward title, narrative/item/XP/quest-point fields, native source 9..15 text slots, exact continuation request and stable presentation identity.
Opaque confirmations with real title/lines/items/u64 credit, pagination, accept/cancel and Escape.
Selected/visible/permitted abilities and interface states; combat style association retains identity even if view row ordering changes.
Equipment bonuses/weight and exact native equipment-preview request geometry; no missing-stat zero defaults.
Stable bank entries/tabs, drag/move/new-tab/collapse, placeholders, original placeholder sprites, note/amount/insert preferences and deposit-equipment permissions.
Death-preview kept/lost rows, exact fee strings and value revision. Unsupported alternate scopes retain their source controls and feedback.
Recovery coffer balance, discard permission/request and inventory coffer offering, with confirmation identity retained and no local credit/item changes.
Public chat permission, declared channel and UTF-8 byte limit; rejected drafts retained, no optimistic echo or clearing before the authoritative own-message update.
Declared body_type 0/1 permissions and confirmation, with local appearance/equipment preview descriptors. Human kit/colour/pronoun controls do not create new penguin variants.
All shop buys still send displayed canonical expected_item; held menus/amounts never retarget a reused row.

Native master/music/effects/area sliders and per-channel mute controls consume actual audio observations, preserve remembered in-session positions and source integer/nonlinear semantics; title audio uses explicit global mute rather than resetting all channel positions.

Player-scoped setUiMusicState delegates the exact published state to the audio engine. Native modes, canonical manual tracks, actual unlock coloring/counts, current playlist, loop flags, scrollbar and source dropdown cancellation are wired without fabricated music events or caller-selected next songs.

requests.scope: Real backend/protocol/shell implementation of the published contract
requests.extension: No new fork: implement the published GameplayUiView/GameplayUiIntent and project WorldView.ui.version=1 through AppServices.state/subscribe/send.
requests.reason: The exact type publication is integrated, but component service-double acknowledgements do not prove protobuf transport, authoritative execution, canonical data, persistence or the real-server journey.

requests.extension: GameplayUiView.production.target: WorldTarget | null, with the corresponding authoritative Rust/protobuf correction relayed by its owner.
requests.reason: The published d1532d6 target is nonnullable. Runtime null explicitly reports ui.production.target.unsupported. No dummy facility is manufactured for dough or another inventory-only recipe.

requests.scope: Source Make-All and persistent bank All defaults
requests.extension: Publish the exact bank_set_options.amount All encoding, and either an authoritative production all-quantity value or an explicit All request mode.
requests.reason: The current u32 fields do not define either sentinel. The original All controls remain visible and report required integration. Withdraw-All already uses the current authoritative bank entry quantity; it is not blocked by this question.

requests.extension: Publish RecoveryView.items.cost unit-versus-stack semantics, effective unit fee/capacity/per-row UiPermission/bank-all permission, and identity-bound partial-quantity retrieval and bank-all requests.
requests.reason: reclaim currently accepts whole recovery item IDs only. Partial 1/5/X cannot become a full-stack reclaim; fee units and capacity cannot be inferred. Null per-row display permission stays unknown, while existing whole-item requests remain server-validated. Coffer, discard and coffer-offer fields are now wired and no longer requested as missing.

requests.extension: Publish canonical reward.interface IDs and corresponding current source widget/style bindings for each required level-up chat/popup variant; use the existing kind/interface fields, not a second reward contract.
requests.reason: Only interface.quest_reward currently has a canonical source association in the published content catalogue. Other reward layouts explicitly display ui.source.reward.layout with the real payload and continuation, not a fabricated quest scroll. Native level-up variants remain required.

requests.extension: Continue supplying WorldView.bank.banker alongside an open GameplayUiView.bank, or publish the replacement identity-bound ordinary-deposit request.
requests.reason: The v1 bank projection itself contains no banker identity. Existing bank_deposit still requires it. The UI explicitly reports contextual_banker_identity if a v1-only bank omits that required legacy context.

requests.scope: Dynamic minimap and real model-only previews
requests.extension: Renderer/shell must provide the actual changing minimap surface plus base tile/plane/source mask state, and consume getUiPreviewRequest(handle) with setUiPreview(handle, nativeSizeModelSurface).
requests.reason: The UI now exports source widget/model bounds, native model parameters, approved local body selection and authoritative equipment/base metadata. Static minimap rasters and absent previews are not a finished renderer. These are component adapters, not new server defaults or shared-ABI edits.

requests.scope: Real source audio listener/object/varp and music-state app composition
requests.extension: Use setSourceAudioScene with real 128-unit listener, plane/instance/owner, placed emitters/orientations and original varps; call setUiMusicState(ui, playerId, actual SourceMusicState) after audio.update(world, events).
requests.reason: UI/state integration and native internal continuation are implemented. Actual shell/renderer inputs remain outside UI ownership. No caller-guessed gain, empty scene or next-song callback is required or supplied.

requests.scope: Direct skip request and numbered playlist slots
requests.extension: Expose a direct Skip Track request into the audio engine's existing native next-track policy; supply saved Playlist1/2/3 identities/contents for the original numbered-slot controls.
requests.reason: SourceMusicState and UI controls now cover actual modes/unlocks/manual selection/current playlist/loop flags. It does not identify three saved slots, and identical-state idempotence is not a skip API. No mode-flipping workaround or caller-guessed next track is used.

requests.scope: Native remembered mute values and full settings window
requests.extension: Expose the actual remembered mute percentages (source varbits14817/12426/12427/12428) when restoring persisted settings. Complete the separate All Settings window projection.
requests.reason: Current percentages/mixers and source sidebar sliders are wired. In-session Mute/Unmute preserves the observed previous value. A zero value whose saved restoration value was never supplied reports ui.audio.remembered_mute instead of inventing it. The broader All Settings button has explicit required feedback, not a silent open acknowledgement.

requests.scope: Committed Cook reward/Widget153 close audio batches
requests.extension: Shell must forward coherent before/after skill observations and committed level_up events with skillId, preserved sourceId and matching completion attribution; forward actual committed Widget153 close with questId/completionId.
requests.reason: The authorized audio gate handles pre-trained/multi-level gains and suppresses no-level-gain rewards. UI continuation remains a request, not proof of close, XP delta or permission to create a level-up event.

implementation_gaps_without_contract_ext: Complete source-selected/highlight/hidden/disabled projection coverage for every required current-source signature and live 71-state route. The existing 71 states/29 families/11 signatures are preserved, not reduced or declared accepted.
Complete native level-up chat and popup layouts once their canonical association is supplied; current explicit failure/continuation coverage is not visual completion.

Matched full-panel source comparisons for remaining live bank-tab/placeholder/highlight variants and their canonical data, beyond the preserved original bank replay and current versioned interaction tests.
Real-server startup-to-quest-completion journey, reconnect/restart/concurrent-state behavior and final visual/audio/hardware acceptance remain separate gates.
